# Method GetEnumerationDefinitions

#### GetEnumerationDefinitions(out List<Guid>, out List<string>)

Gets the available enumeration definitions.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
void GetEnumerationDefinitions(out List<Guid> outGuids, out List<string> outNames)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  List<Guid> |  outGuids |  GUIDs of the available classes defining an enumeration.  |  
 
|  List<string> |  outNames |  Localized names of the classes.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
